name: popcorn-workflows
description: Deterministic, YAML-defined AI development workflows for coding agents: enforced phases, gates and human approvals. Claude Code today, GitHub Copilot on the roadmap.

scripts.build: esbuild src/cli/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --minify --outfile=plugin/dist/popcorn.mjs --metafile=plugin/dist/meta.json --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs && rm plugin/dist/meta.json
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vitest run tests/e2e
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && vitest run
